rows.text: En pavimento mojado los neumáticos tienen menos adherencia que en seco, por lo que aumenta la distancia necesaria para detenerse.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, Highway Code rule 227, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/driving-in-adverse-weather-conditions-226-to-237: wet roads reduce tyre grip and increase stopping distance.

rows.text: Cuando el agua no se evacua con suficiente rapidez, se forma una película entre el neumático y la calzada y la rueda pierde contacto y adherencia.
evidence: Texas Department of Transportation, Hydraulics Manual, Hydroplaning, https://www.txdot.gov/content/txdotoms/us/en/manuals/des/hyd/chapter-10--storm-drains/section-4--pavement-drainage/hydroplaning.html: when tread and pavement drainage capacity is exceeded, a water wedge can lift the tire and eliminate friction; speed and tread depth affect hydroplaning.

Georgia Department of Driver Services, Drivers Manual, Hydroplaning, https://dds.georgia.gov/drivers-manual: tires channel water away; hydroplaning can remove road contact and cause an uncontrollable skid; adequate water-channeling tread helps prevent it.

rows.text: Una banda de rodadura muy desgastada evacua menos agua, por lo que en las mismas condiciones el hidroplaneo puede comenzar a menor velocidad.
evidence: NHTSA, Tire pressure FMVSS 138, pp. V-56–V-57, https://www.nhtsa.gov/sites/nhtsa.gov/files/fmvss/tirepressure-fmvss-138.pdf: speed, tread depth and water depth affect hydroplaning; worn tread is less able to remove water.

NASA, A systematic experimental investigation of significant parameters affecting model tire hydroplaning, conclusions, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/archive/nasa/casi.ntrs.nasa.gov/19740003931.pdf: hydroplaning inception speed increases with tread depth.

Texas Department of Transportation, Hydraulics Manual, Hydroplaning, https://www.txdot.gov/content/txdotoms/us/en/manuals/des/hyd/chapter-10--storm-drains/section-4--pavement-drainage/hydroplaning.html: when tread and pavement drainage capacity is exceeded, a water wedge can lift the tire and eliminate friction; speed and tread depth affect hydroplaning.

rows.text: Las ranuras permiten que el agua salga de la zona de contacto. Si no basta, el neumático puede elevarse sobre una película de agua.
evidence: Texas Department of Transportation, Hydraulics Manual, Hydroplaning, https://www.txdot.gov/content/txdotoms/us/en/manuals/des/hyd/chapter-10--storm-drains/section-4--pavement-drainage/hydroplaning.html: when tread and pavement drainage capacity is exceeded, a water wedge can lift the tire and eliminate friction; speed and tread depth affect hydroplaning.

Georgia Department of Driver Services, Drivers Manual, Hydroplaning, https://dds.georgia.gov/drivers-manual: tires channel water away; hydroplaning can remove road contact and cause an uncontrollable skid; adequate water-channeling tread helps prevent it.

rows.text: El riesgo aumenta con la velocidad, no al reducirla: el agua tiene menos tiempo para salir de la zona de contacto.
evidence: NHTSA, Tire pressure FMVSS 138, pp. V-56–V-57, https://www.nhtsa.gov/sites/nhtsa.gov/files/fmvss/tirepressure-fmvss-138.pdf: speed, tread depth and water depth affect hydroplaning; worn tread is less able to remove water.

rows.text: El hidroplaneo elimina adherencia y puede causar derrape y pérdida de control, en vez de reducirlos.
evidence: Texas Department of Transportation, Hydraulics Manual, Hydroplaning, https://www.txdot.gov/content/txdotoms/us/en/manuals/des/hyd/chapter-10--storm-drains/section-4--pavement-drainage/hydroplaning.html: when tread and pavement drainage capacity is exceeded, a water wedge can lift the tire and eliminate friction; speed and tread depth affect hydroplaning.

evidence: NHTSA, Tire pressure FMVSS 138, pp. V-56–V-57, https://www.nhtsa.gov/sites/nhtsa.gov/files/fmvss/tirepressure-fmvss-138.pdf: speed, tread depth and water depth affect hydroplaning; worn tread is less able to remove water.

rows.text: La nieve y el hielo reducen la adherencia. Una velocidad moderada da más posibilidades de controlar el vehículo y detenerse.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, Highway Code rules 230–231, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/driving-in-adverse-weather-conditions-226-to-237: greater stopping distance on snow and ice; slow down and accelerate, brake and steer gently, especially on bends.

rows.text: En nieve o hielo aumenta la distancia de detención: una mayor separación deja más espacio para detenerse.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, Highway Code rules 230–231, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/driving-in-adverse-weather-conditions-226-to-237: greater stopping distance on snow and ice; slow down and accelerate, brake and steer gently, especially on bends.

rows.text: Con poca adherencia, una aceleración brusca puede hacer patinar las ruedas. Hay que acelerar gradualmente.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, Highway Code rules 230–231, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/driving-in-adverse-weather-conditions-226-to-237: greater stopping distance on snow and ice; slow down and accelerate, brake and steer gently, especially on bends.

Oregon DMV, Commercial Driver Manual §2.19, https://www.oregon.gov/odot/DMV/Pages/Online_CDL_Manual_2/Section_2.aspx: excessive acceleration can spin drive wheels and cause a skid, particularly on ice or snow.
Georgia Department of Driver Services, Commercial Drivers Manual §2.2, https://dds.georgia.gov/section-22: accelerate gradually when traction is poor; excessive power can spin the drive wheels.

rows.text: Frenar con fuerza sobre nieve o hielo puede causar un derrape. Conviene reducir la velocidad con anticipación y frenar suavemente.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, Highway Code rules 230–231, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/driving-in-adverse-weather-conditions-226-to-237: greater stopping distance on snow and ice; slow down and accelerate, brake and steer gently, especially on bends.

rows.text: Acelerar al máximo al arrancar puede hacer patinar las ruedas sobre una superficie resbaladiza; hay que acelerar suavemente.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, Highway Code rules 230–231, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/driving-in-adverse-weather-conditions-226-to-237: greater stopping distance on snow and ice; slow down and accelerate, brake and steer gently, especially on bends.

Georgia Department of Driver Services, Commercial Drivers Manual §2.2, https://dds.georgia.gov/section-22: accelerate gradually when traction is poor; excessive power can spin the drive wheels.

rows.text: Un giro brusco sobre nieve o hielo puede causar pérdida de adherencia y control. Hay que anticipar el obstáculo y maniobrar suavemente.
evidence: UK Department for Transport, Highway Code rules 230–231, https://www.gov.uk/guidance/the-highway-code/driving-in-adverse-weather-conditions-226-to-237: greater stopping distance on snow and ice; slow down and accelerate, brake and steer gently, especially on bends.

rows.text: En una curva con pavimento resbaladizo es más fácil perder adherencia: hay que reducir la velocidad antes de entrar y pasar con cuidado.
evidence: UK Department for International Development, Motorcycle Rider Training Instructor Manual, pp. 56–58, https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/5fa19888e90e07042c1e10f0/Transaidetal-2020-InstructorsManualCBCMotorcycleRiderTraining-Generic-AfCAP-RAF2114A-190524__1_.pdf: slippery surfaces reduce traction; slow before curves and avoid sudden inputs.

rows.text: Con menos adherencia se necesita más espacio para detenerse. Una mayor separación ayuda a parar si el vehículo de adelante reduce la velocidad.
evidence: UK Department for International Development, Motorcycle Rider Training Instructor Manual, pp. 56–58, https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/5fa19888e90e07042c1e10f0/Transaidetal-2020-InstructorsManualCBCMotorcycleRiderTraining-Generic-AfCAP-RAF2114A-190524__1_.pdf: slippery surfaces reduce traction; slow before curves and avoid sudden inputs.

rows.text: Una velocidad moderada y lo más uniforme posible reduce la necesidad de maniobras bruscas, que pueden causar derrapes en pavimento resbaladizo.
evidence: UK Department for International Development, Motorcycle Rider Training Instructor Manual, pp. 56–58, https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/5fa19888e90e07042c1e10f0/Transaidetal-2020-InstructorsManualCBCMotorcycleRiderTraining-Generic-AfCAP-RAF2114A-190524__1_.pdf: slippery surfaces reduce traction; slow before curves and avoid sudden inputs.

evidence: UK Department for International Development, Motorcycle Rider Training Instructor Manual, pp. 56–58, https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/5fa19888e90e07042c1e10f0/Transaidetal-2020-InstructorsManualCBCMotorcycleRiderTraining-Generic-AfCAP-RAF2114A-190524__1_.pdf: slippery surfaces reduce traction; slow before curves and avoid sudden inputs.

rows.text: Frenar bruscamente en una curva puede causar pérdida de adherencia. Hay que reducir la velocidad antes de la curva, frenando progresivamente.

rows.text: El agua en la calzada reduce la adherencia entre el neumático y el asfalto, lo que dificulta frenar y controlar el vehículo.

rows.text: Las hojas, sobre todo si están mojadas, forman una capa resbaladiza entre el neumático y la calzada y pueden reducir la adherencia.
evidence: London Fire Brigade, Motorbikes, https://www.london-fire.gov.uk/safety/road-safety/motorbikes/: wet leaves and diesel spills are motorcycle skid hazards.

rows.text: La nieve y el hielo vuelven resbaladiza la calzada: las ruedas tienen menos adherencia y pueden patinar con más facilidad.
